I’m Kyle Gontjes, a sixth-year PhD candidate in Microbiology & Immunology at the University of Michigan.

My research integrates clinical metadata and whole-genome sequencing to investigate the evolution and transmission of multidrug-resistant organisms in complex populations, including those in long-term acute care hospitals, nursing home, and household settings.

I conduct my research in the [Snitkin Lab](<https://thesnitkinlab.com/index.php>), where we focus on microbial genomics, molecular epidemiology, and bacterial evolution.

Explore my [research](research.qmd), [publications](<https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=hG4WnBEAAAAJ&view_op=list_works>), [tools](software.qmd), and [CV](cv.qmd) to learn more.
:::

# Next steps!

I am seeking postdoctoral or research scientist positions in genomic epidemiology, with special preference to continuing clinically-relevant research on antibiotic resistance in bacterial pathogens. 

I am defining my PhD on March 11th, 2026. I will be available to start a new position in July 2026. 

Please feel free to reach out if you’d like to connect or know of a relevant opportunity!
